remarks:
Just a few miles north of the Village of Ellicottville, this expansive 4+ acre lot offers an exceptional opportunity to build your dream home in a peaceful, natural setting. Surrounded by mature trees, scenic views, and abundant wildlife, you’ll enjoy the privacy and serenity of country living—while being only a short drive from all the action Ellicottville has to offer. Year round events and 2 top ski areas, a popular mountain bike park is at HoliMont Ski area. Located just 45 minutes from the Southtowns of Buffalo, this property offers the perfect balance of seclusion and accessibility.

Set within Ellicottville’s newest upscale wooded subdivision, the lot is conveniently positioned near miles of recreational trails and just a quick trip to both Holiday Valley and HoliMont ski resorts. Access is easy via Route 219 and Lindberg Road from the North, and the lot sits proudly at the top of scenic Poverty Hill. Build toward the southern end of the parcel, and you’ll capture sweeping views of the ski slopes—a stunning year-round backdrop.

You’re free to choose your own builder, or work with the owner/developer to bring your dream chalet or year-round home to life. An HOA is in place to protect your investment with sensible restrictions and to handle the  road maintenance. With its unbeatable location, breathtaking surroundings, and growing value, this is the ideal time to begin your building plans—and have your new home ready in time for next ski season.
